title: NIGHTJAR
caption: Most of David Gray's albums drop as a surprise to me.  I don't obsessively follow many of my favorite artists, but DG is as close as I follow anyone because he's still actively involved in the songwriting process. A week ago, while writing something of my own, I was processing some thoughts and, as I often do, turned to my library of his materials to get lost for a while. I believe this is the second time I've been caught off guard by an album that's less than two weeks away from its wide release. I haven't given it a listen yet; that would be a fine excuse for a blog entry.

title: ARCADE_NO_MORE
caption: When you look at this picture, what do you feel? This picture takes me back to reading books for free pizza, trips to Metrocenter, and the small nerves of asking Mom for a quarter. As more and more of life becomes ephemeral and impersonal, I find myself hoping we don't let all of this disappear. May arcades, bookstores, and physical media survive in some form. That's my vote.
